invariant.subject: homestead
invariant.source: Among its provisions was a five-year requirement of continuous residence before receiving the title to the land
invariant.relation: When a land claim turned into ownership

candidates: The story is about the condition linking a land claim to ownership: receiving title required five years of continuous residence on the land. The reader should understand that making a claim and receiving title were distinct stages, with residence required before ownership was granted.
- **Development:** Explain the supported condition: five years of continuous residence was required before title could be received.
- **Endpoint:** Clarify that a land claim did not itself amount to title; ownership was conditional on meeting the residence requirement.
